asset.name: BulkActionWorkflow
asset.description: The multi-item action flow explaining scope, validating eligibility, previewing impact, confirming, reporting progress, and recovering from partial failure item by item.

requires.reason: Selection scope and action affordances are shared.
Long work survives navigation by living in the shared task registry.
Progress and outcomes are announced through the one shared live region.

rationale: Partial failure is the whole design problem. Two hundred records where six fail must name those six and offer a path for them, and must never report the operation as simply failed.
